paragraphs: 2 former Mustangs appeared in professional games on Tuesday for 2 clubs across 2 levels, with Brooks Lee producing the night's most notable performance.
He batted sixth and started at third base.
Minnesota Twins fell to New York Yankees, 1-8.

Drew Thorpe started on the mound for Charlotte Knights. He worked 4 1/3 innings, allowing 3 hits and 2 earned runs, with 4 walks and 3 strikeouts. One of his strikeouts came in the fourth on a 0-2 92 mph four-seam fastball, when he put away Ethan Anderson. Charlotte Knights fell to Norfolk Tides, 2-4.
title: Brooks Lee highlights a busy Tuesday for former Mustangs
